title: Torch-Spyre provenance sidecar v1
description: Authoritative durable mapping from Spyre profiler bundle keys to normalized source provenance and filtered upstream Inductor relationships.

schemaVersion.description: Wire-format version. Readers check this field before JSON Schema validation and reject unsupported versions explicitly.

eventKey.description: Versioned profiler event-key contract shared by every kernel identity in this artifact.

mergeGeneration.description: One-based count of semantic publications. A no-op merge does not increment it.

status.description: Derived artifact completeness: complete only when diagnostics is empty and every upstream projection is ok; partial otherwise.

diagnostics.description: Writer-side failure counts derived from compile projections. Reader rejection diagnostics use a separate vocabulary defined by the resolver contract.

collection-failure.description: Sum of the per-projection distinct uncollected kernel-name counts.

upstream-projection-failure.description: Number of compile projections that observed a failure while capturing or filtering upstream provenance.

handles.description: Normalized DebugHandle records keyed by decimal-string handle ID. An empty map is valid.

kernelIdentities.description: Content identities keyed by the finalized-bundle provenance key.

kernelOccurrences.description: Compile-scoped reconstructed bundles keyed by their derived occurrence ID.

upstreamProjections.description: Compile metadata and filtered upstream relationships keyed by the derived compile ID.

decimalId.description: Canonical non-negative decimal integer spelling without leading zeros.

eventKeyValue.description: Lowercase base32 encoding of the first 80 bits of the SHA-256 finalized-bundle fingerprint.

stringSet.description: Order-preserving array with no duplicate strings.

producer.description: Toolchain versions that produced one compile-scoped contribution.

width.description: Encoded bundle-key width in ASCII characters.

stepAttribution.description: Current JobExecPlan step suffixes resolve to the whole finalized open-source bundle.

settings.description: Strongest upstream provenance and structured-tracing settings observed across contributions merged into one compile identity.

structuredTracing.description: Whether upstream structured tracing was active for any merged contribution.

sourceLoc.description: Structured source range matching MLIR FileLineColRange fields.

file.description: Source filename as recorded by the compiler.

pass_name.description: Compiler pass that performed the transformation.

reason.description: Optional structured explanation supplied by the pass.

handle.description: Normalized DebugHandle. fused_from contains ID references rather than DebugHandle.to_dict()'s recursively nested objects.

id.description: Must equal this record's key in the top-level handles map.

source.description: Unambiguous headline source, or null when constituents disagree or source metadata is absent.

aten_op.description: Unambiguous source-level ATen identity, or null when constituents disagree or metadata is absent.

ir_chain.description: Ordered opaque compiler names. V1 does not infer stage types that production data does not encode.

fused_from.description: Ordered authoritative constituent handle IDs. Every ID must resolve in the top-level handles map.

specHandleBinding.description: One direct handle attachment at a finalized OpSpec position.

specPath.description: Non-empty zero-based index path through the finalized OpSpec/LoopSpec tree.

handleId.description: Directly attached handle ID at this OpSpec position.

kernelIdentity.description: Cache-stable finalized-bundle identity independent of compiler occurrence context.

directHandleIds.description: Ordered first-appearance deduplication of specHandleBindings handle IDs.

specHandleBindings.description: Depth-first finalized OpSpec attachments, retaining position, multiplicity, and order.

atenOps.description: Sorted unique recursive ATen identities reachable from direct handles.

eventNameBase.description: Exact profiler event name before the runtime appends #<step>.

registration.description: One exact upstream registration retained from a scheduler codegen call.

ordinal.description: One-based compile-scoped ordinal returned by upstream registration.

kernelOccurrence.description: One finalized sdsc() bundle reconstructed for one compiler kernel in one compile identity.

compileId.description: Key into upstreamProjections. Availability belongs to that compile-scoped projection, not this deduplicated occurrence.

compilerKernelName.description: Exact sdsc_* name used by the generated wrapper.

registrations.description: Ordered exact aliases observed during fresh codegen; empty on cache replay or provenance level 0.

selector.description: Reserved optional opaque exact-match occurrence token supplied by runtime event metadata. V1 writers omit this field.

compileKernel.description: One wrapper kernel used to derive compileId in finalized wrapper order.

nameMap.description: Upstream graph-name relation preserving upstream value order.

kernelStackContext.description: Kernel-level display context copied from upstream, not handle-level structured provenance.

upstreamProjection.description: Compile-scoped producer/settings metadata plus a filtered cache of upstream-owned v2 relationships.

source.description: Upstream artifact whose live state was filtered.

kernels.description: Ordered wrapper kernel list used to derive this map key as the compile ID.

uncollectedKernels.description: Sorted set of compiler kernel names that belonged to this wrapper but could not safely produce a bundle identity.

upstreamProjectionFailed.description: Whether this compile observed a failure while capturing or filtering upstream provenance.

upstreamJoin.description: Best available alias/projection status after merge. Richer data is never replaced by a weaker status.

kernelStackTraces.description: Reachable stack context keyed by exact registration alias.
